hook.en: Before a single Mysore Pak is sold, someone has decided what customers want, how to pack it, what to charge and where to sell it. All of that is marketing.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಮೈಸೂರು ಪಾಕ್ ಮಾರುವ ಮುನ್ನವೇ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಏನು ಬೇಕು, ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಬೆಲೆ ಎಷ್ಟು, ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಯಾರೋ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅದೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ.

narration.en: Before a single Mysore Pak is sold, someone has decided what customers want, how to pack it, what to charge and where to sell it. All of that is marketing.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಮೈಸೂರು ಪಾಕ್ ಮಾರುವ ಮುನ್ನವೇ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಏನು ಬೇಕು, ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಬೆಲೆ ಎಷ್ಟು, ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಯಾರೋ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅದೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ.

body.en: Traditionally a market is a place where buyers and sellers meet; in modern marketing, a market means the set of actual and potential buyers of a product. Marketing is a social process by which individuals and groups obtain what they need and want through creating, offering and freely exchanging products and services of value with others. A marketer is the person who organises the exchange.
body.kn: ಆಧುನಿಕ ಅರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನದ ವಾಸ್ತವ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರ ಸಮೂಹ. ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ವಿನಿಮಯದ ಮೂಲಕ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪೂರೈಸುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ.

title.en: On the board: Marketing as exchange

narration.en: Old meaning: a market is a place. Modern meaning: all actual and potential buyers of a product.

say.en: Old meaning: a market is a place. Modern meaning: all actual and potential buyers of a product.
Marketing is an exchange: the seller offers a product of value, the buyer gives money.
It starts with needs and wants, creates a market offering and delivers customer value.
Almost anything can be marketed: goods, services, ideas, persons, places, events.

title.en: Marketing management and what is marketed

body.en: Marketing management means planning, organising, directing and controlling marketing activities to facilitate exchanges. It is the art and science of choosing target markets and getting, keeping and growing customers by creating superior customer value. Almost anything of value can be marketed: physical products, services, ideas, persons, places, experiences, events and organisations.
body.kn: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಎಂದರೆ ವಿನಿಮಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮಾರಾಟ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳ ಯೋಜನೆ, ಸಂಘಟನೆ, ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ. ವಸ್ತು, ಸೇವೆ, ವಿಚಾರ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ಸ್ಥಳ, ಘಟನೆ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

problem.en: The government runs a campaign urging people to wear helmets on two-wheelers. Is this marketing? Identify what is being marketed.

steps.en: Marketing is creating and offering something of value to influence exchange.
Here the 'offering' is a safety idea; people 'pay' by changing their behaviour.
Ideas can be marketed just like products and services.

answer.en: Yes; an idea (road safety) is being marketed.
